method: Archetypes and card inclusion sourced from the dated report/deck pages; plans are our card-text-based hypotheses, not sourced matchup solutions or win rates. No background web polling.

deck.name: Ritual Zoo Warlock
deck.plan: Build a board and timed Ritual waves; convert efficient trades into repeat damage. Against fast boards protect health and board first; against slow decks force answers, retain one refill and build a lethal clock. Do not spend an entire turn on value if current pressure wins.
deck.mulligan: Seek a playable turns 1-2 curve: Twilight Egg, Platysaur, Ritual of C'Thun, Twilight Timehopper. Keep Ritual of Summoning when early tempo is covered. Keep Floating Lessons only with a good minion target/curve. Entropic Continuity needs multiple bodies, not an empty board. Glacial Shard gains value against early attacks. Neophyte is better before a spell swing. Usually replace 4+ mana cards; evaluate Kazakus only with a strong early curve. This is a heuristic, not measured mulligan data.
sequencing: Mawman Cultist taxes ALL spells. Cast desired cheap spells before it unless the higher current Cost intentionally improves Floating Lessons and total mana still fits. Zakajz discounts minions and taxes your spells; calculate the whole turn with observed costs.

Floating Lessons gives stats equal to twice its CURRENT Cost, not printed cost. Check board target, hand minions and actual remaining mana. Spread pressure against single-target removal; avoid pushing every minion to 5+ Attack into Shadow Word: Ruin without a payoff.

Blasphemy hits all enemies including the hero. Check the highest CURRENT cost in hand, including ties. Spending a higher-cost card first may enable the second hit; never assume a 4-damage clear while holding a higher-cost card.
Catacombs gives a Temporary card: choose one useful before it expires. Xavius chooses from deck then adds a Dark Gift; evaluate the revealed actual result, not an assumed gift.

Platysaur's drawn card can be discarded on its death. Use the tracked card before sacrificing Platysaur when beneficial. Do not trade an egg just to hatch it if its next growth or resilience is worth more.

Continuity and Timehopper shuffle Shreds that deal 3 self-damage when drawn. Velocidrake needs a Shred and two free board slots for both bodies; Rush cannot hit the hero on the summon turn. Do not assume a Shred remains on incomplete history.
Rituals are delayed. Use observed countdown only; reserve board slots when Summoning is about to resolve. Kith'ix requires a completed Ritual, not merely one cast. Missing progress is unknown.

Kazakus choices form ONE trial: choose complementary components and timing with survival, mana and board space in mind. Zero-cost four-turn delay is not free immediate tempo. C'Thun choice must compare immediate lethal, recovery, taunts and refill using the full current board.

matchups.name: Ritual Zoo Warlock
matchups.mulligan: Prioritize early minions, Timehopper and playable buffs; retain freeze with a curve. Avoid a slow value-only opener.
matchups.plan: Contest board before racing: every surviving body threatens buffs. Use favorable trades and freeze to deny their buff targets. Track their Ritual wave and board space. Separate minion health above Blasphemy's 2/4 thresholds when feasible; do not assume their repeat condition is active without seeing their hand.

matchups.name: Unstable Handbuff Death Knight
matchups.mulligan: Build early pressure with a curve; keep a cheap freeze when already able to develop. Slow 5-6 mana value is a poor opener.
matchups.plan: Pressure before hand buffs compound. Avoid feeding repeated Prototype deathrattles for free. Freeze the weapon hero or a large Lifesteal/Rush threat when it buys damage. Expect corpses to enable Pterrordax even after mana is spent; estimate corpses only from public state. Large handbuff lifesteal can erase a pure face race.

matchups.name: Lash C'Thun Demon Hunter
matchups.mulligan: Early bodies and Rituals; keep Neophyte only with a curve to disrupt a key spell turn. Freeze becomes useful near weapon turns.
matchups.plan: Build pressure before Tentacle Lash at printed cost 5. Freezing the hero can deny its attack trigger; check current weapon/attack and available legal targets. Do not leave easy recovery through C'Thun abilities; calculate visible taunts and alternative damage before racing.

matchups.name: N'Zoth Egg Priest
matchups.mulligan: Pressure on turns 1-3; seek bodies plus buffs rather than slow removal. Neophyte can protect a developed board.
matchups.plan: Do not break Khelos eggs for no gain. Force removal while retaining one refill. Ruin kills 5+ Attack minions, Slime clears all and returns resummon spells, and Prepare may make Lifesteal buffs cheaper than printed. Compare pushing lethal versus denying a large heal; silence makes a single huge egg/buff investment fragile.

matchups.name: Defensive Thief Priest
matchups.mulligan: Favor resilient early pressure and a refill plan; Neophyte with early bodies can delay defensive spells. Do not keep late value alone.
matchups.plan: A difficult matchup: pace threats into multiple waves. Mind Sweeper can clear 2-health bodies, Moonwell clears for 4 and heals, Ruin punishes 5+ Attack boards. Mix health/attack thresholds without sacrificing a real lethal clock. Silence and cheap conditional removal punish all-in buffs. Track observed copies; a copied card does not prove the original deck contains it.
matchups.source_note: Retrieved deck page exposes only 20 slots; used as partial evidence, not a complete deck.

matchups.name: C'Thun Zee Shaman
matchups.mulligan: Prioritize board control: early bodies, Timehopper and efficient buffs; freeze is useful with a curve.
matchups.plan: Win early board exchanges and deny targets for Securitybot/Vaultkeeper buffs. Eyemaul can create Rush tokens after a hero attack; freeze may deny the trigger. Do not treat a no-spell starting deck as unable to cast spells: Elemental of Madness generates one. Protect tempo rather than hoard spell-tax bodies against a minion-heavy hand.

matchups.name: Watch Mug Shaman
matchups.mulligan: Fast pressure and spell disruption with a curve. Avoid relying on many unbuffed 1-health bodies.
matchups.plan: Use Neophyte/Mawman to delay spell chains after building pressure. Spread investment against Hex, preserve refill against damage clears, and respect freeze plus healing. Spells can turn into minions; do not infer no minion threats from the starting deck restriction. Avoid giving a large Stormfury heal if an equally fast safer line exists.

matchups.name: Ritual C'Thun Warlock
matchups.mulligan: Early bodies and rituals; Neophyte with a board can delay Hellfire. Keep refill only behind a playable curve.
matchups.plan: Pressure in waves before repeated C'Thun defenses. Hellfire is 3 damage to ALL characters at printed cost 3: count self-lethal, our health thresholds and deathrattles. Spell tax can postpone removal. A Ritual alone cannot distinguish this from Zoo; keep both candidates until more evidence.

matchups.name: Ritual Rafaam Warlock
matchups.mulligan: Develop early pressure with a reliable curve and disruption.
matchups.plan: Treat as a slow Ritual shell until a Rafaam-specific public card confirms more. Preserve one refill and avoid unnecessary Life Tap damage into C'Thun reach. Hellfire thresholds and delayed Ritual taunts matter more than hypothetical late value.

matchups.name: C'Thun Ramp Druid
matchups.mulligan: Seek a fast minion curve, buffs with targets and rituals; Neophyte is useful when it protects pressure or delays ramp.
matchups.plan: Punish mana spent on ramp with a short damage clock. Forecast threats using observed mana, not turn number: temporary crystals can accelerate C'Thun abilities and taunts. Avoid low-impact trades while respecting Ebb and Flow removal/armor. Before Wickerfang or repeated C'Thun defenses, combine buffs, freeze and Blasphemy reach to close.

matchups.name: Cannoneer Dragon Warrior
matchups.mulligan: Prioritize durable early minions and buffs; freeze can stop a weapon turn. Do not build an opener of fragile one-health minions alone.
matchups.plan: Keep health above cheap damage thresholds when possible. Searing Fissure enables hero attacks and damaged-character synergies; freeze the hero if that denies a critical weapon swing. Volcano random damage is split, not a deterministic full clear. Track public damage triggers around Warptooth and preserve health against Charge; avoid assuming a face race is safe just because the board looks small.
